name: notion
description: Notion MCP: read and write to Notion workspace (Spaces, pages, databases). Remote server, OAuth.
notes: Add to .cursor/mcp.json.source: "notion": { "url": "https://mcp.notion.com/mcp" }. Run python3 .scripts/cursor-sync-mcp.py and restart Cursor. First use: OAuth in browser to connect workspace. Use for: read info in Spaces, create new pages. Not yet wired into PRD-push flow.
